purpose: Qualify manufacturable butterfly material and attachment tiers while preserving the external manufacturing-geometry authority and generating controlled physical mass inputs for suspension and kinetic engineering.

controlledContext.parameterStatus: RFQ/prototype design inputs; thickness values are not final released material specifications
controlledContext.manufacturingGeometryAuthority: external controlled VX4800 Product Release v1.3.0

commercialTiers.intent: lightweight, repeatable, cost-controlled transparent sculptural element
commercialTiers.materialDirection: cast optical/architectural PMMA such as PLEXIGLAS GS Clear or approved equivalent
attachmentDirections: small edge/yoke capture where geometry permits

commercialTiers.intent: premium engineered optical/decorative glass with controlled repeatability
commercialTiers.materialDirection: borosilicate or other engineered lead-free premium glass with supplier-controlled properties; SCHOTT BOROFLOAT 33 is the present data-reference candidate
attachmentDirections: engineered edge clamp/cradle with compliant interface
qualified bonded metal pad only if validated as a safety-critical system with independent retention

commercialTiers.intent: artisan hand-worked glass with visible craft character and project-specific matching
commercialTiers.materialDirection: specialist artisan glassmaker process; glass composition, annealing and mechanical properties supplier-specific
attachmentDirections: integral formed loop/boss if the glassmaker validates it
mechanically captured cradle designed around the artisan form

attachmentPrinciples: Use three-point orientation control only after the final butterfly material and local attachment geometry are qualified.
Avoid sharp cable or metal bearing directly on glass edges or drilled holes.
Use compliant isolation/sleeves/pads only with compatible material, aging and creep evidence.
Do not treat adhesive-only attachment as an approved primary overhead load path without dedicated durability testing and independent retention.
Keep the complete butterfly attachment replaceable during service.
Do not use Blender yoke geometry as attachment engineering authority.
massControlRequirements: prototype at least one production-intent S, M and L butterfly for each tier advanced beyond research
measure complete suspended assembly mass including butterfly, attachment hardware, lower bridle/yoke and terminals
record scale resolution, calibration status, sample ID and environmental condition
measure center of gravity or balance reference where it materially affects hanging orientation
define production mass tolerance before kinetic balancing is released
do not calculate final mass from bounding-box volume
mandatorySupplierReturns: exact material grade/composition and supplier trade name
available stock or process thickness and tolerance
density or mass-property basis for engineering calculations
optical transmission/refraction data where relevant to the tier
minimum edge distances and hole rules if drilling is proposed
regional manufacturing and replacement lead time
engineeringPromotionGates: exact material grade and production process selected for the tier
complete S/M/L suspended assembly masses measured and controlled
attachment detail frozen for the tier
attachment proof-load test passed on production-equivalent samples
fatigue/cyclic test passed for intended kinetic duty
failure/fragment-retention strategy resolved for occupied-space installation
optical and cosmetic acceptance standard frozen
production mass tolerance and matching/spares strategy frozen
supplier quality and traceability returns accepted
rejectionRules: Do not promote the current 5/6/7 mm RFQ parameters into final material thickness without supplier and test evidence.
Do not derive final mass from coordination geometry or a bounding box.
Do not use generic glass or PMMA strength values as proof of a finished drilled/clamped butterfly assembly.
Do not approve a glass attachment solely because a hole or clamp can be modeled in CAD or Blender.
Do not assume an artisan glass composition, density or strength before the selected glassmaker provides controlled data.
Do not approve an adhesive-only overhead primary load path without durability qualification and independent retention.
Do not allow a presentation/render material to become manufacturing authority.
